name: Shadowed Dimension
source:
You play as “John”, a lonely young man who spends his days escaping into video games and anime — a world far safer than the one outside. But one morning, on his way to school, something unexpected happens. A sudden accident, a mysterious boy, and an encounter that blurs the line between life and death.

Later that night, the same boy appears again — this time in John’s own room — offering him something beyond comprehension. Experience a story of mystery, choice, and dark temptation as John’s quiet life begins to spiral into the unknown.
translation:
你将扮演孤独的青年“约翰”。日复一日，他总是躲进电子游戏与动漫的世界里——毕竟那里远比外面的现实安全得多。然而某天清晨，在他赶往学校途中，意想不到的变故突如其来：一场骤然降临的意外、一名神秘莫测的少年，以及一次模糊了生死界限的邂逅。

当晚深夜，同一名少年再度现身——这一次就在约翰自己的房间里——向他开出了一份超乎常理的提议。随着约翰平静的生活步步滑向未知的深渊，亲自体验这段交织着悬疑、抉择与黑暗诱惑的故事吧。
